# Cloud Calendars

> Calendar views and weather for iPhone and iPad, developed by ARTE SOFT EOOD. Connect supported calendars while keeping their ownership and permissions distinct.

## Product

- [Cloud Calendars](https://www.cloud-calendars.com/): calendar views, weather, Home Screen widgets and plan information.
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cloud-calendars-sync-widget/id6744690319): current version, availability, local pricing and supported devices.

## Capabilities and limits

- Day, Week, Month, Year and List views, including a multi-calendar overview.
- Base includes Google Calendar sync, Google Meet support, weather and Home Screen widgets. Advanced removes ads. Premium adds Microsoft Calendar and Microsoft Teams support.
- Local calendars can be used on the device without an app account. Provider connections and sharing services may require sign-in and the appropriate permissions.
- Available weather depends on location, dates and the provider. A month of calendar dates is not a month of available forecasts.
- Read-only calendars remain read-only; a subscription does not override calendar-owner or workplace restrictions.

Requires iOS 18 or later. Check current local subscription terms before purchase. This website contains English guides and translations; only existing versions are linked. Availability in a language does not imply that every article has a translation.
